decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA shows $154,800 total income and the current pay stub annualizes to about $153,000, both supporting the stated $148,500.

Chequing balance of $234,869 with a 3-month history covers the $196,200 down payment plus closing costs, and the $60,000 deposit is explained by a signed gift letter from a sibling stating no repayment.
Ironbridge Valuation Ltd. (on the approved panel) appraised at $793,000 on 2026-08-19, supporting the $785,000 price, with no adverse conditions.
GDS is about 37.5% but TDS is about 46.1% (above the 44% limit) with a 694 credit score, so a possible marginal-exception case must be escalated.
